title: We really enjoyed our...
text: We really enjoyed our walk with Maria. It was a gentle walk but be prepared to be a little tired at the end, especially in the heat. Maria was very knowledgable and friendly and answered our many questions.
author: Joseph_W

title: Fun and informative
text: Julio was very friendly and informative.  Definitely worth doing this tour.  I came to Seville many years ago and saw all the beautiful buildings; now I know about a lot of them and also a lot of the history of Seville and Spain.  Doing this tour at the beginning of your stay in Seville will make your visit more memorable. Thank you Julio.
